releaseNotes: Live TV stays on by itself. A channel that stopped feeding without any error used to sit frozen until you pressed Resync - the player now notices the picture has stopped and reconnects on its own. And when a channel is unavailable because all your connections are in use, or the internet is down, it no longer gives up for good: it keeps trying quietly in the background and comes back when the connection frees up. Update from Settings - Check for Updates.
